summary: Iteration 98 - Webstore Checkout Gating (Rule C). All features verified working: (1) Stripe Connect status for signguypa@gmail.com returns connected=false, stripe_mode=live, (2) Public storefront API exposes checkout_enabled, checkout_status, checkout_message fields, (3) Storefront allows browsing and add-to-cart when checkout is inactive, (4) Cart drawer works correctly when checkout is inactive, (5) Checkout dialog opens but final place-order button is disabled with clear message, (6) No storefront regression for product display/cart behavior.
critical_code_review_comments: Public storefront API correctly sanitizes webstore data - does not expose tenant_id, payout_owed, payout_paid, total_profit
Checkout gating logic in webstores.py correctly checks tenant's stripe_connect_account_id and account.charges_enabled
Frontend Storefront.js correctly reads checkout_enabled from API and disables place-order button accordingly
checkout_message provides clear user-facing explanation of why checkout is inactive
Product data correctly hides base_cost from public API to protect profit margin info
seed_data_creation: Used main agent's seeded data: store_id=fc0bad7e-9040-477e-93b9-a3f0b1a2df90 (Preview Storefront QA), product_id=b3c51047-4bc9-4d6e-b3cb-9023bb6a2ee6 (Preview Tee)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Checkout gating feature (Rule C) fully implemented and tested. Public storefront API exposes checkout_enabled, checkout_status, checkout_message fields for frontend gating.
